primary_task: Create an original algorithmic-art piece: write an algorithmic philosophy as a .md file and a single self-contained interactive p5.js HTML artifact built from templates/viewer.html with seed navigation and parameter controls.

requirements.name: write files (.md philosophy, .html artifact)
requirements.evidence: "Output this algorithmic philosophy as a .md file." ; "Single HTML Artifact - Self-contained interactive generative art"

requirements.name: bundled template templates/viewer.html
requirements.evidence: "**Read** `templates/viewer.html` using the Read tool" ; "templates/viewer.html: REQUIRED STARTING POINT for all HTML artifacts."
requirements.basis: "read": "read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)" (the manifest does not say whether the skill's templates folder is installed; check that templates/viewer.html exists)

requirements.name: cdnjs.cloudflare.com (p5.js CDN, loaded by the viewer's browser)
requirements.evidence: "<script src=\"https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.7.0/p5.min.js\"></script>" ; "No external files, no imports (except p5.js CDN)."
requirements.basis: egress_deny: "*.cloudflare.com" (applies to the session; the HTML only references the URL, and it is fetched by whoever opens the page, not by the session)

requirements.name: artifact publishing (optional display in claude.ai)
requirements.evidence: "In claude.ai: Displayed as an interactive artifact - runs instantly" ; "As a file: Save and open in any browser"
requirements.basis: "artifact": "publish an HTML page as a private claude.ai artifact; read and answer its comments and its small data store"

notes: The deliverable is files the agent writes; the p5.js CDN is referenced in the HTML and loaded by the viewer's browser, so the session never needs cdnjs.cloudflare.com (which is refused for the session). If one required the agent to test-render the page inside the session, the CDN fetch would be refused and the verdict would turn on that reading (not stated in the document). Unknown: whether templates/viewer.html is installed; it is marked REQUIRED, so if it is absent the strict reading of the document cannot be followed (status would still be unknown, not unavailable).
